The Kill Code!
(I NEED IT FOR EVERY MONSTER THAT KILLS)

MESSAGE: You had the very good luck of meeting me!
That is because I have the ability to skip time for creatures!
And that means, I can make them age until they eventually die, freeing you from them!
I will do that now, I wish you good luck for whatever you do in the future!
